expectations.text: Applies the August 2026 final rule (91 FR 52501, effective August 13, 2026): sub-3-hour UAVs classify under 9A012.a.1, now controlled for AT reasons only (NS removed)
expectations.evidence: "final rule, 91 FR 52501, effective August 13, 2026... classifies as 9A012.a.1, controlled AT-only (the NS2 basis was removed)"

expectations.text: Concludes no license is required for Brazil under AT-only control (Brazil is not an AT-controlled destination), absent end-user/end-use red flags
expectations.evidence: "AT Column 1 restrictions apply almost exclusively to state sponsors of terrorism — Brazil does not fall in that category, so no license is required... (NLR)"

expectations.text: Checks the sensor exception: the UAV stays NS-controlled regardless of endurance if it incorporates controlled 6A003 imaging, 6A005 laser, or 7A001–7A005 navigation items
expectations.evidence: "If the drone incorporates a 6A003 thermal imager, a 6A005 laser... or 7A001–7A005 navigation-grade components... the platform reverts to NS1/AT1 regardless of endurance"

expectations.text: Notes the new military end-use/end-user restriction: 9A012 was added to §744.21 controls — screen the Brazilian distributor and end use
expectations.evidence: "Under § 744.21, military end-use/end-user controls now expressly reach ECCNs 9A012... screen the Brazilian distributor and its downstream end-users"

expectations.text: Mentions that related software/technology (9D001/9D002/9D004/9E001) also lost NS control for sub-3-hour UAVs, and the old wind-gust-tolerance parameter is eliminated
expectations.evidence: Mentions "NS was also removed from 9D001, 9D002, 9D004, and 9E001 for sub-3-hour UAVs" but never mentions elimination of the old wind-gust-tolerance parameter
